name: PR list FINDINGS column shows severity counters and opens the findings popover
description: On the PR list, the seeded PR #482 (one review with one CRITICAL and one WARNING finding) must render a FINDINGS column between SCORE and STATUS. Opening its popover lists the findings themselves. The trigger is toggled by click rather than hover so the flow stays deterministic (the HoverCard opens on both). Read-only seeded data (no model call). Assumes the freshly-seeded hermetic stack — see e2e/README.md.
